query:
SELECT op.productName, op.color, SUM(op.quantity) as total_qty
FROM orders o
JOIN orderProducts op ON o.id = op.orderId
WHERE o.orderNumber IN ('26EGB0326', '26EGB0311', '26EGB0293', '26EGB0265', '26EGB0262', '26EGB0261', '26EGB0245', '26EGB0238', '26EGB0235', '26EGB0217', '26EGB0209', '26EGB0196', '26EGB0198', '26EGB0169', '26EGB0151', '26EGB0143', '26EGB0136', '26EGB0113', '26EGB0110', '26EGB0100')
GROUP BY op.productName, op.color
ORDER BY total_qty DESC, op.productName
LIMIT 10 OFFSET 20;
